plain_text:
DefinitionsProvides GEER terms and their definitions as used within the GEER reporting
Annual ReportingContains the annual reports and applicable reporting periods
Burden StatementFull text of the Burden Statement• To open and close the burden statement, select the Burden Statement bar
Page NavigationA list of sections within the report• To navigate between sections, select the desired number
Status IndicatorShows the current status of the Annual Performance Report• Not Started: Annual Performance Report has not been started• In Progress: Annual Performance Report has been saved at least once• Submitted: Annual Performance Report has been submitted
Last ModifiedShows who last modified the report including the date and time it was modified
